verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region is a fair question for a cloud payroll and HR SaaS like RUN, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions data residency, region selection, or where customer data is stored. The multi-state payroll and API Central OAuth items cover other capabilities and do not address storage location.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
